subtitle: Every save keeps the old version.

sync.title: Sync with your machine
sync.body: Keep a copy of this project on your computer that matches the server. Set HEIMDALL_TOKEN to an API token, then run:
sync.rules: pull and push never overwrite a file changed on the other side. They list the clashes and stop. Add -force to overwrite. Files up to 64 MiB sync. Files over 1 MiB keep no old versions.
sync.tokenLink: Create an API token in Settings
sync.localToken: On a local server, use its write token, BENCH_WRITE_TOKEN. pull needs no token.
sync.summary: Sync with your computer using the command line

empty: Empty folder. Create a file or upload a zip.
badName: Use a relative name without ".." or a leading slash.
readOnly: Read only. Ask an admin for the member role to edit.

editor.binary: This file is binary and cannot be edited here.
editor.conflict: The file changed since you opened it. Reload, then apply your edit again.

pickFile: Pick a file on the left, or create a new one.
